info.title: DocDuniya API
info.description: Healthcare marketplace and provider platform. All routes are under /api/v1. Commands require an Idempotency-Key; mutations use optimistic expectedVersion where documented.

get.description: Readiness: the database answers and is a replica set (transactions are required). Load balancers should route traffic only while this returns 200; liveness stays on GET /health.

post.description: Password step: no session yet; a code is emailed to the administrator.
Code step: a session, or the authenticator step when one is enrolled.

get.description: One snapshot read; explicit public projection excludes residences, account IDs and evidence.

post.description: Safety and privacy tickets are prioritized; a linked patient never grants chart access.
Only the patient side of a completed appointment can review it, once, pending moderation.

get.description: Public reviews show only rating, text, date and the provider's reply; no patient identity.

post.description: Platform finance records a verified provider payment for the subscription.
One current subscription per provider. Commercial status never removes clinical records.

get.description: Dead-letter view and replay for operators. Replay is safe because consumers deduplicate.
Platform review authority never implies provider membership or patient access.

post.description: Reservation protocol: ensure calendar anchors, then in one transaction write every touched resource/day anchor in deterministic order, check overlaps and create token-bound claims.
Cancellation releases resources and computes the refund obligation from the policy snapshot.
Reserves the new interval and releases the old one atomically; the booking identity is kept.

Independent platform activation. A provider's own staff cannot activate its merchant.
Only drafts can be discarded; an issued invoice is corrected through credit notes.

get.description: Trial balance computed from immutable journals, never from a cached balance.

post.description: Resolves an exception. A missing local capture is re-fetched and applied through the normal path.
Patient starts payment for a prepaid hold. One intent per hold token; the amount is server-derived.
Checkout success callback. The signature proves origin; the amount comes from a server fetch.

get.description: Patient portal: issued invoices of an authorized patient profile across providers.

post.description: Patient pays an issued invoice online.

get.description: The signed-in account's provider workspaces, for navigation: each current membership with its organization, facility scope, roles and the union of their permission codes, plus pending invitations. It uses the same validity rules as `authorizeOrganization`, so a permission listed here is one the server currently grants; every command still re-checks it.

post.description: Grants an additional built-in role to an existing active member. Self-assignment is allowed only for the owner of a solo practice (who is also its clinician). Clinical actions still require the professional's own verified credentials.
Starts an encounter. Walk-ins need no appointment. Starting care creates the attending practitioner's care-team assignment, which is the evidence later reads rely on.
Adds another member of the provider to the patient's care team (e.g. the ward nurse).
A referral transfers responsibility, not records: sharing still needs the patient's consent.
Drafts are editable by their author only; signed notes change through amendment or addendum.
Amending a signed note keeps every prior revision; the author re-attests the new content.
Releases a signed note to the patient portal (prescriptions are released on signing).

get.description: Full prescription with its items, for the treating team.

post.description: Discontinues one medication; the signed prescription itself is never rewritten.
Signing validates authorship, privileges, draft completeness and the expected draft version, then seals an immutable revision and signature with the head change in one transaction.
Marks a record entered in error. The original content and revisions are preserved.

get.description: Current chart summary for the treating team. Missing allergy data is reported as UNKNOWN.
Another provider's view of records held by other custodians, only under a current patient grant for that resource family and record period. Reads are audited per disclosure.

post.description: Acknowledgement and completion are distinct facts; a sent alert proves neither.

get.description: Patient-mediated view across every custodian: signed prescriptions, released notes, recorded allergies, active problems, immunizations and visit history. Drafts are never shown.

post.description: Placing an order seals it as a signed revision; an order is not proof the test happened.

get.description: Facility worklist with the minimum patient context needed to collect and identify samples.

post.description: Records preliminary results. Every result is validated against its order, specimen and patient.
Verification finalizes results and creates result-review (or critical-result) work for the orderer.
Corrections create new revisions; the original verified values remain in history.

get.description: Treating team view: orders and reports (including preliminary) within the custodian organization.
Patient portal: verified reports only, across every performing provider.

post.description: The browser's completion message is only a hint; the server verifies the stored object.

get.description: Patient portal: own uploads plus provider documents explicitly released to the patient.

post.description: Explicit provider release of a document to the patient portal.
Evidence that a version was shown and accepted; never a substitute for specific consent.
Patient (or verified representative) shares chosen record families with one provider.
Withdrawal stops future consent-dependent access immediately; copies already disclosed remain.
A provider records telemedicine or procedure consent obtained from the patient.
Break-glass: an eligible clinician at a provider where the patient is registered gains short, named, audited chart access. Every use is reviewed afterwards.

get.description: Machine-readable export of the patient's own data across providers; audited before disclosure.
Patients see which providers read their records; individual staff identities are not disclosed.

post.description: Erasure is decided against legal retention and holds; clinical and financial records are retained.

get.description: Investigative access is itself audited.

post.description: Operational changes; occupancy is set only by bed-assignment commands.
Ends the old assignment and begins the new one atomically; the bed state follows.
Administration is recorded independently of dispensing; GIVEN needs the actual dose and time.
Corrections are linked ENTERED_IN_ERROR events; the original entry is never rewritten.
Inpatient vitals are observations, never a separate embedded vitals history.
Completing the summary item requires a signed discharge summary for this patient.
Clinical discharge is distinct from physical departure, cleaning and financial closure.
Approval needs a second person; ordered lines are then fixed.
Received goods enter quarantine; release is a separate quality decision.
Quality release moves quarantined stock to dispensable; a recall blocks the batch everywhere.
Transfers post a paired debit and credit in one transaction.

get.description: Items whose dispensable stock is at or below the reorder point.

post.description: Finalizes a dispense: validates the signed prescription, remaining and refill quantity, batch release and expiry, allergy review and nonnegative stock, then records movements and charges. Any failure rolls back every effect.
Returned medicine goes to quarantine with provenance; it is never automatically saleable.
Independent platform decision. Approval verifies the exact registration version reviewed and replaces any earlier approval (one current approval per professional).
Suspends a current approval: the professional loses licensed privileges at once.

get.description: Public: the questions a patient will be asked for this service.
Public type-ahead over active concerns (display text and synonyms).

post.description: Routes selected concerns to specialties. Emergencies return emergency advice and are marked not bookable: the patient is told to seek emergency care instead of a routine appointment.
The patient (or a representative with medical authority) answers before the visit.

get.description: Patient view of their own submitted intake.

post.description: Publishing seals the content hash; answers always reference the exact version shown.
Publishing seals the content hash; answers always reference the exact version shown.

put.description: Attaches a published questionnaire (the provider's own or a platform template) to an offering.

Accepting places an ordinary hold at the current price; payment then follows the booking flow.

get.description: Inbox: administrative threads for the front desk at the member's facilities; care threads only for patients on the member's own care team.

post.description: Either the surviving identity's owner (claiming a record a provider created for them) or a provider holding both registrations requests a merge. Only unclaimed records merge: an account owner's identity can never be absorbed into another account.

Either the surviving identity's owner (claiming a record a provider created for them) or a provider holding both registrations requests a merge. Only unclaimed records merge: an account owner's identity can never be absorbed into another account.
Independent review; approval marks the duplicate MERGED and records it on the survivor.
A patient (or representative) records their own policy.
A patient (or representative) records their own policy.
Records the payer's decision as received (portal, letter or integration).
Submits issued invoices of one patient to their payer. Each invoice may be on one open claim only, and the claim cannot exceed the invoices' outstanding balance or an approved pre-authorization.

Posts the payer's remittance: an INSURANCE receipt (cash/bank debit, advances credit) applied to the claim's invoices oldest first. Any disallowed remainder stays on the invoice as the patient's responsibility.
The indicating clinician (care team, current credential) requests a theatre case.

get.description: Theatre board for a day: times, theatre and status only; clinical detail needs chart access.

post.description: Theatre coordination: books a theatre slot without overlap and assembles the team. Each team member gets a care relationship for the patient, so the team can read the chart.
Records one checklist phase. Every required item must be confirmed; phases run in order: sign-in and time-out before incision, sign-out before the patient leaves theatre.
Records one checklist phase. Every required item must be confirmed; phases run in order: sign-in and time-out before incision, sign-out before the patient leaves theatre.
Records one checklist phase. Every required item must be confirmed; phases run in order: sign-in and time-out before incision, sign-out before the patient leaves theatre.
Incision only after sign-in and time-out; the operating surgeon must hold a current credential.
Verifies the raw bytes, durably inserts a deduplicated inbox row, then acknowledges. Returns false when the signature is invalid. Persistence failures propagate so the gateway retries.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per logical command (UUID). Replays return the original result.
